# New-ZbxActionOperation

## SYNOPSIS

Builds an action operation for the -Operation of New-ZbxAction and Set-ZbxAction.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxActionOperation [-OperationType] <ZabbixOperationType> [-EscalationPeriod <string>] [-EscalationStepFrom <int>] [-EscalationStepTo <int>] [-EvalType <ZabbixConditionEvalType>] [-OperationCondition <ZabbixActionOperationConditionRequest[]>] [-OperationMessage <ZabbixActionOperationMessageRequest>] [-OperationMessageGroup <ZabbixReference<ZabbixUserGroup>[]>] [-OperationMessageUser <ZabbixReference<ZabbixUser>[]>] [-OperationCommand <ZabbixActionOperationCommandRequest>] [-OperationCommandGroup <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHostGroup>[]>] [-OperationCommandHost <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]>] [-OperationGroup <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHostGroup>[]>] [-OperationTemplate <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>[]>] [-OperationInventory <ZabbixActionOperationInventoryRequest>] [-OperationTag <ZabbixActionOperationTagRequest[]>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

An operation is what an action does when its conditions match: send a message, run a script, add a host to a group or link a template. The New-ZbxActionOperation cmdlet writes it as a hashtable keyed by the API's field names, which the -Operation of New-ZbxAction and Set-ZbxAction take as it is, alone or in an array. -OperationType is positional. Nothing is sent to the server, so the command needs no connection.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Send the default message to a user group

```powershell
$notify = New-ZbxActionOperation -OperationType Message -OperationMessageGroup (Get-ZbxUserGroup -Name 'Operators') -OperationMessage @{ default_msg = 1 }
New-ZbxAction -Name 'Notify on disaster' -EventSource Triggers -Operation $notify |
    Select-Object ActionId, Name, EventSource
```

One operation of type Message; -OperationMessageGroup takes user group objects (a builder resolves no names, so read the group first). default_msg = 1 sends the media type's default message; mediatypeid 0 (omitted) means every media.

### Example 2: Escalate: notify first, run a script if the problem persists

```powershell
$trigger = Get-ZbxTrigger -Name 'Too many requests on web-01'
$operations = @(
    New-ZbxActionOperation -OperationType Message -EscalationStepFrom 1 -EscalationStepTo 1 -OperationMessageGroup (Get-ZbxUserGroup -Name 'Operators') -OperationMessage @{ default_msg = 1 }
    New-ZbxActionOperation -OperationType Command -EscalationStepFrom 2 -EscalationStepTo 2 -OperationCommand @{ scriptid = (Get-ZbxScript -Name 'Restart web service').ScriptId } -OperationCommandHost (Get-ZbxHost -Name 'web-01')
)
$condition = New-ZbxActionCondition -ConditionType Trigger -Operator Equal -Value $trigger.TriggerId
$null = New-ZbxAction -Name 'Escalate web problems' -EventSource Triggers -EscalationPeriod '15m' -Filter @{ evaltype = 'AndOr'; conditions = @($condition) } -Operation $operations
(Get-ZbxAction -Name 'Escalate web problems' -SelectOperations).Operations | Format-Table operationtype, esc_step_from, esc_step_to
```

-EscalationStepFrom/-EscalationStepTo place an operation on the escalation ladder; step 2 starts one -EscalationPeriod after step 1. -OperationCommand names the global script (scope Action) and -OperationCommandHost the host to run it on.
